verdict.rationale: Cloudflare docs explicitly claim you can 'use your preferred language, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more' on Workers, and a separate Containers feature claims to run 'any programming language, built for any runtime' — but independent community feedback directly disputes this, citing 'lack of Python support' as a main blocker to building more on the platform. Missing for 10: first-party evidence resolving this contradiction (e.g., docs distinguishing beta/limited Python support, Go language support entirely unaddressed, and independent hands-on confirmation that non-JS languages work in production without major caveats).
